Question_text: When a seed germinates, the stem of the seedling grows upwards. A student wanted to investigate the effect of light and dark on the growth of seedlings. She grew some seedlings in the light and some in the dark, for the same length of time. The photograph shows the seedlings at the end of the investigation.

Some scientists wanted to investigate the effect of fertiliser on the growth of wheat. Wheat seeds were planted in soil to which nitrogen fertiliser had been added. After the seedlings had grown to a height of 8 cm, they were measured at regular intervals.
The photograph shows the bone from the upper leg (between the hip and knee) of two different adult humans. The bones are labelled C and D.
Milk contains casein, a protein that gives it a white colour. A student tested the effect of a protease enzyme on this protein.
